scenario.topic: Choose a weekend trip that mixes relaxation and adventure
scenario.opening_question: How should we balance relaxation and adventure for our weekend trip?

options.name: Lakeside Cabin with Kayaking and Hiking
options.upside: Peaceful lakeside setting with easy access to kayaking and scenic hiking trails
options.tradeoff: Limited nightlife and dining options nearby
options.concern: Cabin amenities are basic, no Wi-Fi available
options.best_for: Those prioritizing nature immersion with moderate physical activity

options.name: Mountain Resort with Spa and Ziplining
options.upside: Combines thrilling zipline adventure with relaxing spa treatments on site
options.tradeoff: Longer travel time reduces actual time at the resort
options.concern: Spa treatments require advance booking and may limit spontaneous plans
options.best_for: Those wanting a mix of adrenaline and pampering

options.name: Beachside Bungalow with Surf Lessons and Yoga

options.tradeoff: Surf lessons are weather dependent and may be canceled if conditions are poor
options.concern: Bungalow is small and shared bathroom facilities might be inconvenient
options.best_for: Those seeking a laid-back vibe with light adventure

options.name: Riverside Camping with Fishing and Evening Bonfire
options.upside: Affordable option with a cozy campfire experience and fishing opportunities
options.tradeoff: Camping requires bringing own gear and weather can impact comfort
options.concern: Limited facilities and potential for bugs or wildlife disturbances
options.best_for: Those prioritizing budget and rustic outdoor relaxation
